description: Is this website legit or a scam? Follows the URL (redirects included) and returns plain-language warning signs: domain age from RDAP (scam shops are usually days or weeks old), look-alike brand names (banks, SARS, couriers, Takealot, PayPal, Apple…), risky domain endings and scam words, look-alike letters, HTTPS, whether the domain receives email and has DMARC. verdict: no_signs, mostly_ok, caution or likely_scam. Warning signs only; not a malware scan.

url.description: Website or link, e.g. example-shop.co.za or https://bit.ly/abc

name: check_website_legit
